stil: Pixar-style 3D animated feature film still, soft cinematic lighting, rich detail, expressive cartoon faces, vertical 9:16 frame

levent.rol: Dükkan TV muhabiri, ana kahraman. Meraklı, enerjik, iyi kalpli, biraz saf; her dükkâna mikrofonla röportaja girer.
levent.kostum: The same young man (same face, same curly brown hair, same proportions). Change ONLY his outfit to: a mustard-yellow (#FFC43D) multi-pocket vest over a red (#D63031) crew-neck t-shirt, cream chino trousers, red sneakers. He holds a small handheld microphone with a yellow cube on it that reads 'DTV'.
levent.tarif: a young man with curly brown hair and big friendly eyes, wearing a mustard-yellow multi-pocket vest over a red t-shirt, cream trousers and red sneakers, holding a small microphone with a yellow 'DTV' cube

cemo.rol: Kameraman, Levent'in yol arkadaşı. Kısa boylu, tombul, kasketli; tembel, sürekli aç, ikram bekler, KASA'dan (bütçeden) sorumludur, kuru espriler yapar.
cemo.kostum: Design a new original cartoon character: a short, chubby Turkish man in his late 30s, round glasses, thick black mustache, grey flat cap (kasket), olive-green bomber jacket over a striped t-shirt, dark jeans, worn brown shoes, an old shoulder-mounted video camera on his shoulder. Friendly but lazy, sleepy eyes. Full body, plain light grey background.
cemo.tarif: a short chubby man in his late 30s with round glasses, a thick black mustache, a grey flat cap, an olive-green bomber jacket over a striped t-shirt, carrying an old shoulder-mounted video camera
